name: Essential Trust Badges
summary: Shopify app (by Essential Apps) that adds payment icons, feature icons, guarantee badges and promo banners to product pages, the cart or any theme position, with your own icons, country targeting and translations; plans are metered on widget views.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want payment icons, feature icons and guarantee or shipping badges under the add-to-cart button without code, starting free, and who will pay $9.99 once they need badges in the cart, per-country badges or translations
skip_if: your cart drawer comes from a third-party app, because the help centre says only theme cart drawers are supported; or you want several distinct badge blocks per product page and refuse to pay, because the free plan allows one banner or one three-icon block
honest_knock:
The free plan is generous on views and tight on badges. It allows 5,000 views a month, more than the vendor's countdown and announcement-bar apps give away, but only one product-page banner or one block of three icons, plus payment icons. A store that wants a shipping promise under the add-to-cart button and a separate guarantee block further down is already on Starter, and uploading your own icon instead of choosing from the library also starts there.

The badge people most often want, the one next to the checkout button, is on the $9.99 Essential plan. The help centre says cart-page and cart-drawer badges are not available on Free or Starter, and adds two limits that are easy to miss: the app supports your theme's own cart drawer only, not third-party cart-drawer apps, and a badge placed with the custom-position method appears on the cart page but no longer inside the drawer. If your store uses a slide-cart app, check this before you pay for the plan that unlocks it.

Views are counted per widget load, so every badge on a page adds a view each time the page opens, including your own visits; preview mode and the theme customiser are not counted. Past the limit nothing is charged, but three days after the warning email the badges are unpublished until the 1st of the month. The critical reviews are few, three one-star and two three-star out of 1,163, and they are about setup rather than billing: one store gave up after a week trying to show two product-page banners, which the vendor replied needed two product-page badges rather than one product and one cart badge, and one wanted more design options without writing CSS. A badge is also a claim: show only guarantees, returns and security marks you actually offer. We have not installed the app.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-30 on apps.shopify.com/essential-icon-badge-banners, on essential-apps.com/trust-badges and in the vendor's help articles on views, cart placement and badges not showing) Four plans priced on monthly widget views. Free covers up to 5,000 views a month, the full icon library, unlimited payment icons on product pages and one product-page banner or one block of three icons. Starter is $6.99 a month, or $67.08 a year at a stated 20% saving, for up to 20,000 views, and adds unlimited product-page blocks, unlimited icons per block and uploading your own icons. Essential is $9.99 a month or $95.88 a year for up to 50,000 views, and adds cart-page and cart-drawer badges, placing badges by product tag, geolocation targeting and translations. Professional is $29.99 a month or $287.88 a year for unlimited views and every premium feature. Paid plans carry a 7-day free trial. A view is counted every time a badge widget loads, not once per visitor, and your own browsing counts too. There is no overage charge: past the limit you get an email, and if you do not upgrade within 3 days the badges are unpublished until views reset on the 1st of the month. All charges are in USD, billed through Shopify every 30 days. Developer Essential Apps, with an address in Vilnius, Lithuania; the listing gives a launch date of 2 June 2023 and shows 1,163 reviews.

free_plan_evidence: Free covers up to 5,000 views a month, the full icon library, unlimited payment icons on product pages and one product-page banner or one block of three icons.

compare_with.name: Essential Announcement Bar
compare_with.why: Essential Announcement Bar is the vendor's sister app and the closest comparison in our own dossiers, because both put store promises in front of shoppers and both are priced on views with the same $6.99, $9.99 and $29.99 ladder. They sit in different places. The announcement bar runs across the top of every page for shipping terms, offers and notices, and on our reading of 29 September 2026 its free plan covered 2,000 views with the scrolling bar starting on Starter. Trust Badges sits on the product page and, from Essential, in the cart, next to the decision to buy, with a free plan of 5,000 views but only one badge block. A store that wants one site-wide message fits the bar; a store that wants reassurance next to the buy button fits the badges, and many stores run both, which means two view counters to watch.
